reference: Why does one unfinished task follow you into bed? In studies, unfinished goals kept intruding on other tasks. Writing a specific plan made those intrusions stop. In a sleep lab, people who wrote a to-do list fell asleep faster than those listing finished tasks. Not a cure, but the loop can wait. So park it: jot down the next step, and when you'll do it. Email Sam, tomorrow at nine. Take a mindful break with Mello.
